fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential network activity of FixMe.it RMM tool
fields.name: Potential FixMe.it RMM Tool Network Activity
fields.query: (event.category in ("dns","url","ip")) and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((url.address contains ".fixme.it" or url.address contains ".techinline.net" or url.address contains "fixme.it" or url.address contains "set.me" or url.address contains "setme.net") or (event.dns.request contains ".fixme.it" or event.dns.request contains ".techinline.net" or event.dns.request contains "fixme.it" or event.dns.request contains "set.me" or event.dns.request contains "setme.net")))
